messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@lumenai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + MPA: Discovery -> Decision (LumenAI pilot qualification)

Hannah — thanks again for carving out time today. Short recap below and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MPA) to keep momentum. Please flag anything I missed or dates that don't work.

Key pains you shared
- Production latency spikes on peak catalog updates (15-20% request timeouts).
- High per-token inference cost limits experimentation across product teams.
- Data governance needs: customer PII must remain in your VPC for regulated workflows.

Goals we heard
- Proof of concept (PoC) validating 95th pctl latency <= 120ms for the search reranking flow.
- End-to-end cost target: <= 0.03 USD per 1k tokens for the pilot workload.
- Confirmable governance controls (VPC private deployment, audit logs, KMS).

Proposed MPA (milestones, dates, owners)
1) Pilot scope sign-off — 2027-09-28 — owner: Hannah Lee (LumenAI)
   - deliverable: final list of reranker endpoints, sample traffic profile, success metrics
2) Private deployment checklist completed (network + KMS) — 2027-10-05 — owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood)
   - deliverable: VPC peering plan, required ingress/egress rules, KMS key exchange steps
3) Performance run & tuning (3 days) — 2027-10-18 to 2027-10-20 — owner: Ben Carter (Redwood)
   - deliverable: latency/cost report, kernel/runtime tuning notes
4) Executive review & decision (pilot -> committed Dedicated) — 2027-10-25 — owner: Hannah Lee (LumenAI)
   - deliverable: go/no-go and procurement approval

Decision process
- Technical sign-off from LumenAI infra/product leads (Hannah + two engineers).
- Commercial approval from procurement (procurement@lumenai.com).

Immediate next steps (this week)
- Hannah to confirm scope sheet by 2027-09-28 (I attached LumenAI_MPA_v1.xlsx).
- Neha and I will send the private deployment checklist and initial network requirements by 2027-09-23.
- I'll schedule the performance window tentatively for 2027-10-18 — Ben, can you confirm availability?

Attachments: LumenAI_MPA_v1.xlsx (MPA draft), SLA_Draft.pdf (SLA expectations)

Thanks — short and actionable. If OK, Hannah can reply with any date changes and procurement contact for contract routing.

—
Logan Wright
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Procurement: looping in procurement@lumenai.com — they asked if we can push the executive decision to 2027-10-27 instead of the 25th (quarterly budget review on the 26th).

I'll review the attached MPA and update it with endpoint details by EOD 2027-09-28. Thanks.

Thanks Hannah — we can accommodate the scope tweak. Quick notes from the infra side and the preliminary cost envelope:

Infra notes
- Firewall / Allowlist: typical turnaround is 48–72 business hours after receiving the required CIDR/IPs from LumenAI and confirmation of peering.
- KMS exchange: we'll need a staging key in your KMS; Neha to share the KMS handshake doc by tomorrow (attachment: KMS_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf).
- Audit logs: we will enable token-level ops logs for the pilot and share a retention policy draft.

Preliminary cost envelope (pilot run estimate)
- Estimated token volume: ~1.2M tokens/day during the 3-day stress run (based on the traffic profile you shared).
- Expected cost: ~36 USD/day for the pilot workload (Redwood hosted pricing equivalent) before autoscaling or batching optimizations.
- Note: cost may adjust after tuning (we typically see 20–40% reduction after kernel-level batching and prefix caching).

I'll attach the KMS checklist now and follow up with the private deployment checklist by Friday 2027-09-24. Ben — please confirm performance window availability for 2027-10-18 to 10-20.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
